run_oneshot_quantization: run oneshot quantization on a GPT-OSS 20B model with W4A8 configuration and save to output directory
convert_model_for_quantization_gptoss: convert GPT-OSS fused MoE experts to LinearExperts for quantization compatibility
create_quantization_args: create QuantizationArgs with 4-bit channelwise symmetric weights and 8-bit per-token asymmetric activations
build_quantization_scheme: build a QuantizationScheme targeting all Linear layers with weight and activation quantization args
apply_quantization_modifier: apply a QuantizationModifier recipe with config groups and ignore list to exclude lm_head
